summary: What the @goifoundation is doing in Ghana is pretty cool. We raised $200, that's it and they are able to provide on the ground training, websites to participants, and a wiki for shared knowledge and locally created and curated #oer.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: What the @goifoundation is doing in Ghana is pretty cool. We raised $200, that's it and they are able to provide on the ground training, websites to participants, and a wiki for shared knowledge and locally created and curated #oer.
